definitions.explanation: The residential areas on the outer edges of a city or town.

examples.japanese: {郊外|こうがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}みたい→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I want to live in the suburbs.

examples.japanese: {郊外|こうがい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住|す}みやすい→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: The suburbs are quiet and easy to live in.

examples.japanese: {郊外|こうがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦ショッピングモール→ショッピングモール：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a large shopping mall in the suburbs.

examples.japanese: {郊外|こうがい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Commuting takes time from the suburbs, but the rent is cheap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれて→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}みたくて→住む：00673_sumu⟧{郊外|こうがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: After our child was born, we wanted to live in a bigger house, so we moved to the suburbs.

notes:
{郊外|こうがい} refers to the residential areas outside the city center.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {郊外|こうがい}に{住|す}む: to live in the suburbs
- {郊外|こうがい}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す: to move to the suburbs
- {郊外|こうがい}の{家|いえ}: suburban house
- {郊外|こうがい}{型|がた}: suburban-type

CHARACTERISTICS:
Suburbs in Japan typically offer:
- More space and quieter environment
- Lower rent/housing costs
- Longer commute times
- Need for car ownership

CONTRAST:
- {郊外|こうがい}: suburbs, outskirts
- {都心|としん}: city center
- {市内|しない}: within the city
- {田舎|いなか}: countryside (more rural)
